basic_info.headline: Senior Software Engineer / Solutions Architect
basic_info.about: 15+ years professional experience in the software industry. Positions held include Software Architect, Senior Software Engineer, Consultant, Analyst and Tester. Application areas include Data Conversion/ETL, Data Migration, Script and Application Development and Maintenance, Telephony, Commercial Software, Financial, Banking, Human Resources, Retail, Manufacturing, Aerospace and Graphical Systems.  I am especially good at finding big bang-for-your-buck solutions that typically save companies a lot of time and money.  I also have one patent awarded (so far), other patents applied for, in the areas of sound engineering and acoustics, with several others in the works.
